htn_kidney.title: Huanglian Jiedu Decoction ameliorates Hypertensive Nephropathy by inhibiting the AGEs-RAGE/MAPK/AP-1 axis: An integrated transcriptomics and network pharmacology study.
htn_kidney.authors: Wang N, Yang S, Li C
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：黄连解毒汤（HLJDD）是一种经典中药，以其“清热解毒”和抗炎特性而闻名，被广泛用于治疗高血压和相关的靶器官损伤。 临床提示：高血压肾病（HN）是一种严重的高血压并发症，其特征是进行性肾纤维化，目前的治疗无法阻止这种纤维化。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive Nephropathy (HN) is a severe complication of hypertension characterized by progressive renal fibrosis, which current treatments fail to halt. Huanglian Jiedu Decoction (HLJDD), a classic traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) renowned for its "heat-clearing, detoxifying" and anti-inflammatory properties, is widely used against hypertension and associated target organ damage. Thus, its potential therapeutic mechanisms against HN warrant in-depth investigation. This study was designed to investigate the renoprotective effects of HLJDD on HN and to determine whether its mechanism is mediated through the modulation of the AGEs-RAGE/MAPK/AP-1 signaling axis. htn_kidney.title: The Role of Non-Coding RNA in the Pathogenesis of Hypertensive Nephropathy.
htn_kidney.authors: Plewa P, Figiel K, Ćmil M
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于综述研究。核心观点：高血压肾病（HN）是全世界慢性肾脏病和终末期肾病的主要原因，是高血压对肾脏结构和功能的长期影响所致。 临床提示：HN的发病机制复杂，涉及血流动力学紊乱、肾血管损伤、氧化应激、慢性炎症和进行性间质纤维化。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hypertensive nephropathy (HN) is a leading cause of chronic kidney disease and end-stage renal disease worldwide and results from the long-term effects of hypertension on renal structure and function. The pathogenesis of HN is complex and involves haemodynamic disturbances, renal vascular injury, oxidative stress, chronic inflammation, and progressive interstitial fibrosis. In recent years, increasing attention has focused on the role of non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs)-including microRNAs (miRNAs), long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs), and circular RNAs (circRNAs)-as key regulators of gene expression involved in these processes. htn_kidney.title: Apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1) and Nephropathy.
htn_kidney.journal: Giornale italiano di nefrologia : organo ufficiale della Societa italiana di nefrologia
htn_kidney.authors: Szyferman AY, Kleppe S, Cristiano F
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于综述研究。核心观点：造成这种差异的一个重要遗传因素是载脂蛋白 L1 (APOL1) 基因，该基因仅存在于非洲血统人群中。 临床提示：G1 和 G2 APOL1 风险等位基因与非糖尿病慢性肾病 (CKD) 的风险升高密切相关，包括高血压肾病、局灶节段性肾小球硬化症和 HIV 相关性肾病
htn_kidney.abstract: Introduction. End-stage renal disease exhibits a disproportionate prevalence among Black individuals and older adults within the United States and worldwide. A significant genetic contributor to this disparity is the Apolipoprotein L1 (APOL1) gene, found exclusively in populations of African ancestry. Materials and Method. We aim to perform a narrative review regarding the current understanding of APOL1 and its complex role in kidney disease pathogenesis. Results. portal_hypertension.title: A randomized controlled trial of L-taurine for fatigue in decompensated cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sasidharan S, Philips CA, Tharakan A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：60%-80% 的肝硬化患者会出现疲劳，但尚无普遍有效的药物治疗方法。 临床提示：牛磺酸是一种具有抗氧化和膜稳定特性的氨基磺酸，可以解决疲劳背后的代谢机制。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Fatigue affects 60%-80% of patients with cirrhosis, yet no universally effective pharmacologic therapy exists. Taurine, an amino sulfonic acid with antioxidant and membrane-stabilizing properties, may address metabolic mechanisms underlying fatigue. We hypothesized that L-taurine supplementation would significantly reduce fatigue severity compared to standard care in patients with decompensated cirrhosis. This single-center, parallel-arm, open-label randomized controlled trial enrolled adults with decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Turcotte-Pugh score 7-13) and clinically significant fatigue (Fatigue Assessment Scale score >22) at a tertiary care center in South India. portal_hypertension.title: Isolated Duodenal Variceal Hemorrhage: A Rare and Unusual Presentation in Newly Diagnosed Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：其他地方没有并发静脉曲张的孤立性十二指肠静脉曲张并不常见，并且对诊断和治疗提出了重大挑战。 临床提示：十二指肠静脉曲张是上消化道出血的罕见原因，通常见于门脉高压以及邻近的食管或胃静脉曲张。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Duodenal varices are a rare cause of upper gastrointestinal bleeding and are typically seen in the setting of portal hypertension along with adjacent esophageal or gastric varices. Isolated duodenal varices without concurrent varices elsewhere are uncommon and pose significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. We report a case of an elderly woman who presented anemic and with coffee-ground emesis and was found to have newly diagnosed cirrhosis with isolated bleeding duodenal varices successfully managed with endoscopic clipping followed by coil embolization performed by interventional radiology.
